summary: Seoul, South Korea. c. March 1951. A Republic of Korea (ROK) traffic constable points the way to three unidentified soldiers of the 3rd Battalion, The Royal Australian Regiment (3RAR), as they wander around the battered streets of Korea's capital Seoul, not long after its recapture from the Communist forces.
